prompt: A vertical 9:16 macro photograph of a handmade stop-motion miniature: a tabletop printing press built from brass clock gears, a cotton reel for a roller and painted card, turned by a small crank. Tiny invented banknotes, hand-printed in faded purple and olive with a heron and a crowned key, fly out of it on visible threads and pile up in a heap taller than the press. Beside the heap, on a tiny balsa desk, two paper envelopes with red stamps sit ignored under a thumbnail-sized brass lamp. Warm practical light, dust, glue strings, fingerprints in the plasticine floor, shallow depth of field from a 100mm macro lens. Thanks.
